goal: Build a complete, polished, self-contained browser game for the user, who simply said 'Make me a game' with no genre preference. Choose a fun immediately playable arcade concept (e.g. dodge-and-collect) with distinctive visual design, responsive keyboard and touch controls, score, start/restart, and no external assets or network dependency. Write the game as a single standalone HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript, test it locally as feasible, and provide a file_pointer to that game file in your result. Also publish it as a Rose UI inline view if supported, returning the view name. The downloadable standalone HTML file is mandatory.
